name: gamelodge-xbox-player
description: The page that plays Xbox home streams in GameLodge (Android WebView, WebView2 on Windows).

scripts.build: esbuild src/glue.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=chrome100 --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/xbox-player/player.js && cp src/index.html src/NOTICE.txt dist/xbox-player/
